# OpenEvidence MCP - Full Machine Context

Project: OpenEvidence MCP  
Repository: https://github.com/bakhtiersizhaev/openevidence-mcp  
License: Apache-2.0 + NOTICE

## Product Definition

OpenEvidence MCP is an unofficial open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects a user's own authenticated OpenEvidence browser session to MCP-compatible AI clients.

Important: this project is not affiliated with OpenEvidence, does not provide medical advice, and does not bypass authentication or access controls.

Availability note: OpenEvidence availability may depend on region, account eligibility, and OpenEvidence policy. Public materials in May 2026 indicate verified U.S. HCP/NPI-centered access and EU/U.K. unavailability. This project does not bypass regional, account, or policy restrictions.

### OpenEvidence Context

OpenEvidence is a medical research product. This MCP server lets users connect their own authenticated OpenEvidence browser session to external AI tools.

## Primary Users

- users with their own OpenEvidence account
- clinicians
- clinical researchers
- medical knowledge teams
- AI operators integrating clinical Q&A into MCP stacks

## Why It Is Used

- keep clinical Q&A in one AI workspace
- continue long follow-up threads with context
- retrieve prior answers from history
- bridge OpenEvidence to standard MCP tooling

## Tool Contract

1. `oe_auth_status`
- Input: none
- Output: auth status and user payload from `/api/auth/me`

2. `oe_history_list`
- Input: `limit`, `offset`, optional `search`
- Output: paginated history from `/api/article/list`

3. `oe_article_get`
- Input: `article_id` (UUID)
- Output: full article payload

4. `oe_ask`
- Input: question, optional `original_article_id`, completion wait controls
- Output: created article and optionally completed article payload

## Auth Model

- Browser-session based
- Uses local storage state file generated by login flow
- Login script validates `/api/auth/me`

## MCP Clients and Integrations

- OpenAI Codex
- Codex CLI
- Codex app
- Claude Code
- Claude Desktop / Claude app with MCP support
- Claude Code
- Cursor
- Cline
- Continue
- VS Code / GitHub Copilot environments with MCP support
- experimental: Windsurf, Zed, Replit, Sourcegraph-style hosts, Gemini CLI / Google Antigravity-style hosts
- any MCP-compatible client that supports local stdio server command/args

## Operator Flows

### Human-first setup
- `README.md`
- short localized READMEs: `README.ru.md`, `README.es.md`, `README.zh-Hans.md`, `README.zh-Hant-TW.md`, `README.ko.md`, `README.hi.md`
- platform scripts in `scripts/`

### Agent-first setup
- `README.AI.md`
- includes Playwright MCP prerequisite and restart instructions

## SEO / GEO Artifacts

- static semantic landing pages in `docs/` and `docs/i18n/*/`
- language strategy: `docs/LANGUAGE_STRATEGY.md`
- canonical URL + hreflang links
- robots: `docs/robots.txt`
- sitemap: `docs/sitemap.xml`
- `llms.txt` + `llms-full.txt` for AI parser discovery
- semantic intent map: `docs/SEMANTIC_CORE.md`

## Distribution

- public GitHub repository
- GitHub Pages-ready docs directory

## Operational Guardrails

- do not commit user auth state
- do not commit `.env` secrets
- preserve `.gitignore`
- preserve `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`
